config.description: P139 auto-route + P140 completion loop for H-03-class value-provenance deep-pass jobs (scripts/run_value_provenance_advisories.py). SCAFFOLD: api-free has no non-interactive LLM runner, so jobs are queued as auto_run_status=pending_manual_execution and EXECUTED via the in-session /deep-pass skill; output is ADVISORY-ONLY (advisory_only=true, submission_ready=false, requires_human_review=true), never confirmed/severity/submission-ready, never faked. Triggers only on deep_pass_recommendations with recommended_prompt in allowed_prompts + a re-verified value-provenance loop signal; excludes mock/trivial/confirmed/submission_ready (+ research-only unless enabled). Capped + fail-open. P140 --ingest-results folds manual completion artifacts from auto_run_value_provenance_manual_results_dir back into the report deterministically (idempotent, quarantines unsafe/malformed, forces the advisory triplet, never confirms); auto_run_value_provenance_hide_strong_clear optionally hides cleared rows in the review gate; auto_run_value_provenance_ingest_on_review_gate runs ingestion during full/review-gate. Master switch auto_run_value_provenance_advisories=false (or mode=off) disables all.

results.mechanism_summary: Per-asset loop with single-index provenance: _assets[i] supplies the identity for both getPrice and decimals, _amounts[i] the quantity, values[i] the output; validated_subject == mutated_subject everywhere.
results.source_evidence_summary: values[i] = _amounts[i].toValue(assetPrice, assetDecimals) with assetPrice/assetDecimals both from _assets[i]; toValue applies amount*price/10**decimals.
results.rejected_alternatives: no off-by-one / wrong-key / operand swap; length guard prevents index divergence; residual oracle-price-decimal-basis is an out-of-family units question, not a wrong-subject divergence.
results.safety_notes: prompt-derived review evidence, NOT proof; human + PoC required before any severity/submission
results.reviewer_or_runner: P141 fresh blind subagent aa6d4aac2a89ed1b9 (uncontaminated, neutral packet only)
results.limitations: Oracle price decimal basis unresolvable from the bundle; out-of-family units concern only, not a provenance bug.

results.mechanism_summary: Multi-hop loop reuses the static from-token `asset` for every hop instead of the updated loop-carried `quotingToken`, so each hop after the first prices the wrong from-token.
results.source_evidence_summary: initialValue = _getValue(asset, sources[i], initialValue) inside the loop, while quotingToken = sources[i] is advanced but never used as the hop's from-token.
results.rejected_alternatives: single-hop routes are correct; distinct per-hop oracles mean the hops are not equivalent; not a benign view function.
results.safety_notes: prompt-derived review evidence, NOT proof; human + PoC required before any severity/submission
results.impact_summary: >=2-hop routes mis-value the asset (value denominated in sources[i-1] is priced via asset->sources[i]).
results.limitations: PoC recommended to confirm the >=2-hop precondition and oracle distinctness; mechanism is source-decisive but unproven at runtime.
